question: Owner: do the agreed conditions one at a time. First, retain current v3 causal scores and exits while entering at the completed touch 5m close.
single_variable: Entry at 1.618 versus its first touch candle close. Completed episodes in that touch bar are not reopened. Same eligible events, pre-touch scores, target bands, stop prices and H1 clock.
confirmation_clock: Touch 5m open floored to H1 plus 120min, identical for resting and touch-close fills; native fill derives it. Prices remain anchored to original 1.618.
controls: Reuse original three random submissions matched by symbol, NY week, side and pre-submission 14bar relative TR bucket. Same parent-selected v3 target ratios, stop and execution policies; no-touch and rejected opportunities stay zero. Conditional geometry comparison, not random score qualification.
admission: No extra EMA/reclaim/volume filter. At the touch close skip if the native original episode already ended in that candle, no source/weekly interval remains, target has no remaining space, or price is beyond original backstop. Accept both inside and outside closes otherwise.
data: Existing Binance 5m altcoin histories, 2020 through September 2026; PROVE October30 is a design observation outside this history.
comparison: Chronological 2020-2024/2025/2026 segments, same-event opportunity returns, matched random controls, NY-week clustered uncertainty, score bands and concentration; no new threshold search.
limitations: Retrospective previously observed history. Causal scoring uses frozen historical approximation of the live score. Limit prices assume pre-positioned orders; close fill has idealized zero latency. No depth, funding or exchange margin model. Independent entry-notional returns, not account returns. Wide original P30 is retained for attribution, not endorsed for sizing.
